neighbours.label: the word 'profit' and its derivatives, firing on the pieces after 'prof' (profiteer, profited, profiting) and on 'profiterole'
fire: People complained loudly about the profiteers who raised bread prices.
The company profited from the war in ways it never admitted.
Critics accused the landlords of profiteering during the housing shortage.
Her favourite dessert is a profiterole covered in dark chocolate.
The shop made a small profit on every umbrella it sold.
Several firms were profiting from cheap child labour on the farms.
The firm's profits doubled after the new factory opened.
The bakery's profiteroles sold out before noon on Sunday.
